content.short: BlockOwls as a project is a story-based NFT adventure on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description: The main goal is to make a playful and vivid fictional world - filled with a variety of characters with colorful appearance and personalities that we can share with each other. The BlockOwls are the first and main characters in this story. It's still unknown where this project will take us as this is just the beginning, but we hope you will join and be a part of this universe. We are a group of artists and CNFT enthusiasts with a huge passion for creating stories and visual concepts.
content.meta: Find out about BlockOwls (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
